items.answer_raw: I have promised to keep thy words.

items.body_raw: בָּא יוֹסֵף מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִקְבֹּר אֶת־יַעֲקֹב
items.answer_raw: Joseph came from the land of Egypt to bury Jacob.
The sons of Jacob went down to Egypt to buy food.

items.body_raw: I promised (said) to pursue after them.
He set the stars in the firmament of the heavens to rule over the night.
items.answer_raw: נָתַן אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לִמְשֹׁל בַּלָּיְלָה

items.body_raw: They left off counting the proverbs of his lips, for they (were) as the sand which (is) upon the shore of the sea.
items.answer_raw: חָדְלוּ לִסְפֹּר אֶת־מִשְׁלֵי שְׂפָתָיו כִּי הֵם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם

items.body_raw: יִקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן יִלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת־יהוה אֱלֹהָיו
items.answer_raw: The king shall read in the book of the law all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God.

items.body_raw: Before he cut off all flesh by the waters of the flood
מַה־טּוֹב לָכֶם הַמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ אִם־מְשֹׁל בָּכֶם אִישׁ אֶחָד
items.answer_raw: Which is better for you—(is it) that seventy men rule over you or that one man rule over you?
